description: This Java class defines an event for the Android 'monkey' testing framework to retrieve and analyze frame rate information for a specific app. It executes shell commands to dump graphics info, parses output to count rendered frames, calculates average frame rate, and logs results to a file.

classes.name: MonkeyGetAppFrameRateEvent
classes.description: Represents an event that interacts with the system to measure an app's frame rendering rate during testing, by executing shell commands, parsing output, and logging the results.

methods.name: getAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Calculates the average frame rate based on total frames and duration.

methods.name: writeAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Logs the calculated average frame rate to a file.

methods.name: getNumberOfFrames
methods.description: Parses the shell command output to extract the number of frames rendered.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Executes the system command to gather frame info, parses results, updates timing info, and logs frame rate data.
